python_carrier_amendment.append_text: Use that selected carrier as the current work reference for context construction and continuation: bind its question, subject/basis, result/evidence references and surviving obligations. Apply bounded qualified acquisition, current-state resumption and exact-result reuse; an actor account cannot replace the carrier, governing sources or current evidence. Preserve required step-produced facts, results and original owner rulings through the admitted result/evidence route. This application creates neither another carrier requirement nor ticket-state authority.
python_carrier_amendment.disposition: Clarifies the source-added carrier application of the existing C03/C07/C08/C10/C23 duties; preserves the sufficient-carrier and authority conditions. Independent review remains required.
python_carrier_amendment.expected_text: Use the smallest lawful work carrier under existing upstream authority. Reuse an exact admitted ticket; otherwise use a durable ticket only when work or an open obligation needs independent surviving state and ticket-state authority permits it; within an admitted sprint use its manifest-local iteration when state ends there; otherwise a one-run contract suffices. No applicable upstream authority means stop/re-entry, not creation of a ticket as substitute. Where surviving state is needed but ticket-state authority is absent, retain the obligation in an already authorized durable surface, withhold the dependent closure and name the re-entry. Carrier, execution and closure retain the same criteria, proof and non-closure conditions.
